description: This file defines the PerformanceMetrics class, a plugin for WPEFramework that provides various performance metrics logging and notification handling. It includes nested classes for configuration, notifications, and different types of metrics loggers and observables, including handlers for callsign, classname, browser, and web browser metrics. The plugin integrates with WPEFramework's plugin infrastructure and defines interfaces for observing plugin and browser state changes, as well as performance logging.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing IPlugin for WPEFramework, handling initialization, deinitialization, and plugin activation/deactivation notifications. Contains nested classes for configuration handling, notifications, and various performance metrics loggers and observables.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::Config
classes.description: JSON configuration container for performance metrics plugin, holding observable callsign and classname strings.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::Notification
classes.description: Implements plugin notification interface to handle plugin activation, deactivation, and unavailability events.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IBasicMetricsLogger
classes.description: Abstract interface for basic metrics logging, including enable/disable and activation/deactivation hooks.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IStateMetricsLogger
classes.description: Extends IBasicMetricsLogger with resumed and suspended states.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IBrowserMetricsLogger
classes.description: Extends IStateMetricsLogger with browser-specific events such as load finish, URL change, visibility change, and page closure.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IObservable
classes.description: Interface for objects that can be enabled/disabled and reactively respond to plugin shell activation/deactivation.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IPerfMetricsHandler
classes.description: Interface for handlers that initialize/deinitialize metrics gathering and respond to plugin shell state changes.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::CallsignPerfMetricsHandler
classes.description: Handles performance metrics specific to a plugin callsign, creating observables based on Callsign matching.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::ClassnamePerfMetricsHandler
classes.description: Handles performance metrics specific to a plugin classname, maintaining a map of observables per callsign.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::LoggerProxy
classes.description: Template class for creating and managing a logger instance for performance metrics.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::BasicObservable
classes.description: Implements IObservable, provides basic enable/disable, activate/deactivate, and logs activities with timestamps.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::StateObservable
classes.description: Extends BasicObservable with plugin state change notifications (resumed/suspended).

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::BrowserObservable
classes.description: Extends StateObservable with browser-specific load and visibility events, and page closure logging.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::WebBrowserObservable
classes.description: Extends StateObservable with web browser-specific load success/failure, URL change, and visibility notifications.
